description: Provide liquidity on both sides of the oracle price. The edge on each side is the larger of a fixed minimum and the price movement that is typical for one minute, measured over the last half hour, so that the vault asks for more when the price moves more. If the vault holds more of the base asset than the target, the edge for buying even more is raised and the edge for selling is lowered, and the other way round. Sizes shrink to zero on a side once the weight reaches the inner band. If the oracle price falls 8 percent or more below its trailing 24 h high, the target weight drops to 35 percent until the price is back within 3 percent of that high. Only if the weight stays far from the target without takers does the agent rebalance through the venue.
